technical-summary: qwen27b -long configs set max_prefill_seqs = 2 beside prefill_interleave = 2; serving config test expects the VTP39 tuning on the long variants. Cap 2 measured on the fixed rad0034 build: eight 100k prompts mean TTFT 434 -> 268 s, short requests 4.6-5.6 s, 0 preemptions.
user-summary-candidate: Long-context qwen27b configs now let at most two long prompts prefill at once, cutting the average wait when several arrive together by about 38% and letting short requests start in seconds.
